unitTitle: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood
title: Words: questions and decisions
subtitle: A2 · Unit 6: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood

steps.exampleFr: Je vais comparer les deux annonces.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to compare the two listings.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais mesurer la chambre avant de choisir.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to measure the bedroom before choosing.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais me renseigner sur les frais mensuels.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to find out about the monthly costs.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais calculer le coût mensuel.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to calculate the monthly cost.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais demander une précision sur le chauffage.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to ask for clarification about the heating.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais faire un choix après la visite.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to make a choice after the visit.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais signer un bail après avoir lu les conditions.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to sign a lease after reading the conditions.

steps.exampleFr: Nous allons nous installer au début du mois.
steps.exampleEn: We are going to move in at the beginning of the month.

steps.explain: se renseigner sur means to find out about.
demander une précision means to ask for clarification.
faire un choix means to make a choice.

steps.title: Words: questions and decisions
steps.body: Rental terms and what utilities include vary by province, landlord and listing. The two notices in this lesson are fictional; do not treat them as current offers or legal advice. A fluent Canadian French reviewer should confirm laveuse, sécheuse, stationnement and bail in context.
